stories.title: Van Zandvoort naar Madrid: ook in de Spaanse hoofdstad leidt F1 tot protest

en.title: From Zandvoort to Madrid: F1 also leads to protest in the Spanish capital
en.summary: Formula 1 holds its first semi-street race in a major European city this weekend in Madrid. While Spanish authorities view the Grand Prix as an international showcase, the event faces local opposition.

stories.title: Trump staat open voor Chinese autofabrieken in VS

en.title: Trump stands open for Chinese auto factories in US
en.summary: Donald Trump expresses willingness to allow Chinese automobile manufacturers to establish factories in the United States.

stories.title: Cabaretier Daniël Arends legt werk tijdelijk neer na hartinfarct

en.title: Cabaret performer Daniël Arends temporarily stops work after heart attack
en.summary: Cabaret performer Daniël Arends has suspended performances following a heart attack in late July. The 46-year-old is focusing on recovery and family, with a scheduled December show cancelled and a tour planned to resume in February 2027.

stories.title: Leerling overleden na reanimatie in zwembad Afferden

en.title: Student dies after resuscitation at Afferden swimming pool
en.summary: A boy from Beuningen died after requiring resuscitation at a swimming pool in Afferden during a school swimming session for special education. The incident occurred on Wednesday; police are investigating the circumstances.

stories.title: Sierra Leone noemt Nederland ‘neokolonialistisch’ na tv-interview met minister Van Weel over ‘Bolle Jos’

en.title: Sierra Leone calls Netherlands 'neocolonialist' after TV interview with minister Van Weel about 'Bolle Jos'
en.summary: Sierra Leone has criticized the Netherlands as neocolonialist following a television interview involving Dutch minister Van Weel regarding a matter referred to as 'Bolle Jos'.

stories.title: Cabaretier Daniël Arends getroffen door hartinfarct, voorlopig geen optredens

en.title: Cabaret performer Daniël Arends struck by heart attack, no performances for now
en.summary: Cabaret performer Daniël Arends suffered a heart attack in late July and is temporarily halting performances. The 46-year-old is recovering well under the circumstances but will not be performing for the time being.

stories.title: Uitspraken van minister Van Weel in tv-interview over Bolle Jos wekken ongenoegen in Sierra Leone

en.title: Statements by Minister Van Weel in TV interview about Bolle Jos cause displeasure in Sierra Leone
en.summary: Dutch Justice Minister David van Weel stated in a Sierra Leonese television interview that he would continue pressuring Sierra Leone to extradite a drug criminal in the country. Sierra Leone's prime minister called the remarks unprofessional and tasteless.

stories.title: Leerling overleden na schoolzwemmen in Gelders Afferden

en.title: Student dies after school swimming in Gelders Afferden
en.summary: A boy from Beuningen died following an accident in a swimming pool in Afferden, Gelderland during a private swimming session organized by a special education school. Resuscitation attempts were unsuccessful.

stories.title: Annet Bremen wint met theaterhit ‘F*ck Lolita’ de Toneelschrijfprijs. Wat maakt die tekst zo goed?

en.title: Annet Bremen wins Toneelschrijfprijs with theatrical hit 'F*ck Lolita'. What makes this text so good?
en.summary: Annet Bremen received the annual Toneelschrijfprijs for her theatrical work 'F*ck Lolita', awarded to the author of the best stage text of the past season. The article examines what makes this text impressive.

stories.title: Slecht nieuws voor de Saoedische olie-export: Houthi’s nemen Mokka in en rukken verder op naar cruciale zeestraat Bab al-Mandeb

en.title: Bad news for Saudi oil exports: Houthis take Mokka and advance further toward crucial strait Bab al-Mandeb
en.summary: Houthi advances along Yemen's western coast threaten to place strategic Middle Eastern sea straits under Iranian and allied control. Saudi Arabia faces drastically reduced oil export capabilities as a result.

stories.title: Annet Bremen bekroond met Toneelschrijfprijs: jury roemt haar urgente en vernieuwende toneeltekst F*ck Lolita

en.title: Annet Bremen awarded Theatre Writing Prize: jury praises her urgent and innovative play text F*ck Lolita
en.summary: Annet Bremen received a Theatre Writing Prize, with the jury recognizing her play F*ck Lolita for its urgent and innovative theatrical text.

stories.title: Houthi’s stomen op en dreigen Bab el-Mandeb onder controle te krijgen: wat maakt die zeestraat zo belangrijk?

en.title: Houthis escalate and threaten to control Bab el-Mandeb: what makes this strait so important?
en.summary: The Houthis are escalating tensions and threatening to take control of the Bab el-Mandeb strait, prompting examination of the strategic importance of this waterway.
